control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setting on CY-3212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 3 July 2004 a corrective action on CY-3212 and PT-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the key safeguard it was raised to restore.
